title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Hennur

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office for sale in Hennur? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel-frame container offices, built at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra (560099) and delivered ready to use across Hennur and the wider city. You buy straight from the people who fabricate the unit, so the specification, finish, and after-sale support all come from one source, not a reseller or an online listing.

A container office is a factory-built, single-room or partitioned workspace on a strong steel base. It arrives finished, levels onto a prepared spot, and is ready for desks, power, and a team within days. Below is what we supply, how we build it, and how to get a current quote for Hennur.

Container Offices for Sale in Hennur

SAMAN Portable supplies new 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft container offices for buyers in Hennur. Each unit is fabricated on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 at our Gopasandra (Bengaluru 560099) factory, finished with insulated wall and roof panels, wiring points, lighting, and a lockable door, then delivered and set up on site. Pricing is shared on enquiry.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard footprints. Each can be left as an open cabin or partitioned, and fitted with the windows, AC points, and electrical layout your team needs.

SizeTypical useLayout
10ftSite office, security or supervisor cabin, single deskOne compact room
20ftSmall team office, sales or project roomOpen cabin or two zones
40ftLarger office, meeting room plus workstationsMulti-zone, partition options

Units are stackable and modular, so two or more can be combined or placed side by side as your team grows. Tell us your headcount and site and we will recommend the right size.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying factory-direct means no middleman markup and a clear line back to the people who built your unit.

  • Built to last: every container office sits on an MS steel frame manufactured to IS 2062.
  • Quality system: SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery: standard delivery is ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days to most Bengaluru locations.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.

The 20–25 years figure is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period. The structural frame and base carry a 5-year warranty, and finishing carries 1–2 years.

Delivery and installation in Hennur

We deliver across Bengaluru, including Hennur and the surrounding areas. Because the unit is fully built at our Gopasandra factory, most of the work is finished before it reaches you. On delivery day the container office is offloaded onto your prepared spot, levelled, and handed over ready for power connection.

For Hennur sites, share your exact address and access details (gate width, turning space, and whether a crane or hydraulic offload is needed) when you enquire. A 40ft unit needs more turning and offload room than a 10ft cabin, so confirming access early keeps installation smooth. Standard delivery is ₹3,000 with 3–5 day transit, and we will confirm timing for your address at the quote stage.

Get a container office quote in Hennur

Tell us the size, layout, and any extras (extra windows, AC points, partition, or a toilet section) and we will prepare a current price for your Hennur site. To buy a container office in Hennur, Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry on our website. You can also browse current specifications and request pricing through our container office range.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Hennur?

We supply 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft container offices. The 10ft suits a single desk or site cabin, the 20ft fits a small team, and the 40ft works for a larger office with a meeting room. Units can be combined for more space.


How long does delivery take to Hennur?

Standard transit is 3–5 days to most Bengaluru locations, including Hennur, with delivery charged at ₹3,000. The unit is built at our Gopasandra factory first, then delivered finished and levelled on site. We confirm exact timing when you share your address.


Can I customise the layout?

Yes. Each container office can be partitioned, fitted with extra windows, AC points, a specific electrical layout, or a toilet section. Tell us your headcount and use, and we will recommend a layout and size to match.


What warranty do you offer?

SAMAN container offices carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty term.


How do I get a price for my Hennur site?

Pricing depends on size, layout, and finishing, so we quote per project. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size, layout, and site details, and we will share a current quote.


Are these new units built to a steel standard?

Yes. Every unit is new and built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 at our Bengaluru factory, and SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
